authorityAndEvidence: No edits, installs, builds, tests, browser/desktop activation, live HTTP requests or runtime-state reads. All source evidence came from pinned git objects. Known baseline Linux compile failure was neither investigated nor used. No finding is claimed as a runtime defect: all witnesses below are proposals. Lead-reported DraftSnapshot implementation is tracked only as coordination, not verified here.
checks: Not run, explicitly prohibited. Source searches/reads only; no claim of passing test-fast or comprehensive, no runtime reproduction.

classificationLegend.A: Already typed at the relevant owner, or typed pure/foreign boundary; TS annotations alone are explicitly NOT claimed to prove runtime JSON validity. Preserve semantic checks.
classificationLegend.O: Retain a justified opaque/raw boundary or intentionally generic serializer/fixture/FFI input.
classificationLegend.R: Remove structural Value/dynamic tree via direct typed Deserialize at Rust ingress and typed Serialize at output. For existing Swift/TS helpers, use the equivalent owner-generated typed codec (Codable/runtime decoder or existing named typed projection); Rust Deserialize is not a TS feature. Keep genuinely opaque nested payload where stated. These are refactoring candidates, not demonstrated bugs.
classificationLegend.U: Unresolved: candidate inspected, but complete replacement needs deeper producer/version/persisted-data proof. Do not delete checks yet.

coverage.exclusions: Exact excluded paths below are excluded only from the executable-source denominator. 41 text configuration/doc/contract files received an auxiliary mechanical scan; referenced owners such as delivery-contract.json, package manifests and README were consulted. 76 binary icons/image/PDF fixtures were inventoried only. No source-extension file was omitted. All untracked paths and other roots are outside this census.
coverage.inspectionDepth: Boundary-producing, decoding and consuming slices in all 83 candidate-bearing production files are represented in the 49-family table, with current caller-gating traced separately. This is not a claim to have manually read every source line or every test. All 176 executable source files were mechanically scanned; 22 production files without a broad match were inventoried, with selected pure/host adapters inspected. Four unresolved family rows explicitly stop short of full historical/schema/producer proof. Supporting web/runtime source was read only as needed for actual caller or contract ownership, not censused as additional assigned roots.
coverage.mechanicalCaveat: Broad matches include comments, cfg(any), iterator any, to/from_slice binary operations, annotations, and inline test code. These are not 991 defects or an exact serde_json::Value-use count. Production line totals include inline tests. The attached per-file list preserves every matched line.
coverage.mechanicalSearch: git ls-tree -r --name-only at exact commit for inventory; git show for every selected source blob; full-file broad line scan; git grep at exact commit for callers/producers and supporting owners. No directory or top-N candidate cap.
coverage.testGeneratedPolicy: Dedicated test files include test/type-test suites, fixtures, examples/check programs, hidden-electron/test support, four native integration/memory witnesses, vitest configs and feature-gated native-check harness files. profile-export-reader.ts is production. Inline cfg(test) modules remain within their production-file count; a first cfg(test) is NOT treated as the end of production. Four generated source files are listed separately. No tracked vendor source in assigned roots.

hashMethod: SHA-256 over lexicographically sorted repository-relative paths, joined by LF with one final LF. ASCII path ordering. Hash identifies list/scope, not blob contents; revision identifies contents.
keyConclusions: The native outer Request/Response are structs but method, params and results are not coupled. Web nativeRequest<T> is caller-chosen; Electron NativeMethods already couples these statically.

Direct typed decode can remove structural primitive checks for many local command and persisted/HTTP envelopes. It cannot replace request identity, receipt equality, workspace correlation, byte/capacity limits, semantic state transitions, permission/gesture provenance or uncertainty handling.
Raw generic HTTP bodies, SSE data, arbitrary preference values, recursive ordered JSON and browser profile values are deliberate boundaries. They should not be forced into one fake domain schema.

Typed Rust DraftVersion/DraftView reconciliation, Markdown AST, WASM pure functions, ApiRequest, startup/recovery records, file action Selection, stored Document and outbox Entry outer struct already exist; remaining Value often sits around those types.

Four U rows preserve unanswered questions for entity/transcript materialization, historical outbox bodies, retained recovery/supervisor documents and delivery/update journal versions. Some typed TS rows also explicitly note runtime-ingress limitations.

DraftSnapshot metadata is a concrete current boundary: C/draft_store.rs:130 turns typed reconciliation into Value then appends revision/workspaceId/error; WEB/native/host.ts:12 hand-extends generated DraftView; NativeDraftState consumes workspace/revision. Lead reports an active implementation assignment; audit stays pinned to baseline.
